description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pangaragammana, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710080 (23/0846)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining title to multiple specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details), along with a detailed schedule of land particulars including extent, ownership, class of title, and encumbrances. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
